name: backup-assets-catalog-sqlite-batch-limit
title: Catalog SQLite 默认批次变量上限修复
description: 修复有效 Rsync mutable point 在默认 2000 条 Catalog 批次下反复快速失败，确保 SQLite 持久化分块并恢复真实资产索引。
creator: weibo
notes: Production v0.50.4 formal Connect succeeded, but Catalog generations 1 through 4 failed in about 0.4 seconds with catalog_build_failed, zero indexed entries, an online/access-active repository, available content/list, and no concurrent Task run. Leading hypothesis: default logical batch 2000 multiplied by CatalogEntry persisted columns exceeds bundled go-sqlite3's 32766 variable ceiling. TDD must confirm the exact SQLite RED before implementation. Production repository remains connected; no SQL repair, manual retry, restart, or node-log re-enable.
